message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine criminal charges based on facts. Facts: Defendant contracted renovation project for 240,000 yuan. From Nov to Dec 2015, hired workers, completed project, then took 220,000 yuan of project payment and left. He paid some wages but still owed 57,000 yuan to ten workers. Labor bureau ordered payment, but he escaped and refused to pay. After police case, he paid the owed wages. He admitted, evidence sufficient.

What crime? Likely "非法占有他人财物" i.e., theft? He was entrusted with project funds? He was contractor, received payment from client for work, then used funds for personal use and didn't pay workers. This could be "诈骗" (fraud) because he obtained money by false pretenses? He contracted, took payment, but didn't fulfill obligations. That's "诈骗" (fraud) under Chinese law: obtaining property by false means. Also could be "非法占有他人财物" (theft) but more appropriate is "诈骗". Also possibly "拒不支付劳动报酬" is a violation of labor law, but criminal? Under Chinese law, refusing to pay wages can be "非法占有他人财物罪"? Actually, under Criminal Law, "非法占有他人财物罪" includes embezzlement? There's also "职务侵占罪" for misappropriation of funds entrusted. He was entrusted with project funds? He was contractor, not a fiduciary of employer. He got payment from client for work, but didn't pay workers. That's fraud: he obtained money by deception (contracting but not performing). So charge: 诈骗.

Any other? Possibly "非法吸收公众存款"? No. "妨害作证"? No. So single offense: 诈骗.

Thus output: [罪名]诈骗<eoa>. JSON format with reasoning and final answer.
